thread:
Elaine: Quick heads-up — OptiCart POC kickoff tomorrow 10:00am PST. Main asks from their side: security questionnaire status, pricing estimate for a 2-week Dedicated trial, and a short eval suite for cart-recommendation prompts. Can we align agenda + owners?

Raj: I can own the eval prompts and perf targets. Need to know training data size and expected QPS. Do we have sample logs from their recommender?

Maria: Security questionnaire is partially filled — waiting on answers for SSO (SAML), data retention, and whether inference logs will leave their VPC. Security team flagged KMS integration for Private deployments.

Tom: Pricing note — for a 2-week Dedicated proof we usually recommend the short reserved capacity plan + burst addon. I'll post a cost estimate in the doc. Also, if they want sub-100ms p50 we should size GPUs differently.

Elaine: @Raj — they said ~10M events/month historically, but POC will use 200k recent events (anonymized). I'll drop a sample CSV in the shared drive after this.

Raj: OK good. For evals I suggest 3 buckets: relevance (nDCG@10), latency (p50/p95), and hallucination (manual spot-check on 100 prompts). Proposed prompt template: "Given a user session and cart items, suggest 3 complementary products with short rationale."

Raj: Example eval harness snippet (python):
```python
# run batched inference against the POC endpoint
for batch in batches:
    resp = client.generate(model="redwood-serve-v1", input=batch)
    save_metrics(resp)
```

Maria: Security Qs we still need from the customer: 1) Are tokens rotated programmatically? 2) Do they require IP allowlist for egress? 3) SOC2 report contact? If they need air-gapped, Private/on-prem will be a longer conversation.

Tom: From infra ops: can they provide a representative request pattern? spike frequency matters for autoscaling. If they expect bursts >500 RPS we need to plan for pre-warm.

Elaine: Stakeholder list for kickoff: OptiCart - Priya (Head of ML), Omar (Platform), Leah (Prod manager). Our side: Elaine (AE), Raj (SE), Maria (CS), Tom (Solutions). Can everyone confirm they'll attend?

Jenny-Bot: Calendar event created: "OptiCart POC Day0 — Kickoff" 10:00am PST tomorrow. Attendees: Priya, Omar, Leah, Elaine, Raj, Maria, Tom. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/opticart-poc

Raj: Quick checklist for tomorrow's agenda (proposed):
- Intros & success criteria (5m)
- Data/connection requirements (10m)
- Eval plan & sample prompts (10m)
- Performance targets & infra sizing (10m)
- Security & compliance Qs (10m)
- Next steps / timeline / owner assignment (5m)

Maria: I'll bring the partial security questionnaire and a slide on KMS/SSO options. Can someone draft a short success-criteria doc we can share live? (3 bullets max)

Elaine: I'll draft the success criteria: 1) nDCG@10 > 0.45 vs baseline, 2) p95 latency < 800ms, 3) zero PII leakage in sample review. Will share in 30m.

Tom: Also add fallback policy: if Dedicated capacity spikes, auto-fallback to hosted smaller model with tracing enabled. Keeps UX up while we scale.

Raj: Last ask — do we have permission to log intermediate prompts for debugging? This affects privacy wording. @Maria pls confirm what the customer allowed.

Maria: Not yet. I'll confirm during kickoff and update the questionnaire.

Elaine: Great — thanks team. If you have slides or numbers drop them in the kickoff folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/opticart/poc-kickoff. See you tomorrow :thumbsup:
